card.name: Inside unusual brand drug names
card.fires_on: The odd middle piece of a brand drug name, mostly the letter Q in INQOVI, TRUQAP and LEQVIO, or 'ule' in Eulexin. It fires in drug label text where the brand name is split into pieces.

modes.label: Q inside brand names
modes.description: The letter Q in the middle of a capitalised brand name such as INQOVI, TRUQAP or LEQVIO.

modes.label: Middle of Eulexin
modes.description: The 'ule' piece in the brand name Eulexin.
